name: CosmosQA
description: Cosmos QA is a large-scale dataset for reading comprehension with commonsense reasoning about everyday narratives. Given a paragraph about someone's personal experience, models answer multiple-choice questions requiring going beyond the literal text to reason about causes, effects, and hypotheticals. Focuses on reading everyday life narratives.
reputation: Large-scale commonsense reading comprehension benchmark based on personal narratives; human performance ~94%; tests causal and counterfactual reasoning
notes: Introduced at EMNLP 2019. Contains 35,588 questions about personal narratives from blogs. Questions ask about background knowledge, causes, effects, and hypothetical situations beyond what is explicitly stated in the text. Four-choice format. Tests pragmatic inference and commonsense reasoning. Human performance 94% vs strong baselines of ~80%.
